input: GitHub’s hackathon reporting offers another reminder about attribution. Participant Lance credits Copilot with creating a frontend and integrating an API in 30 minutes. Elsewhere, GitHub reports Vaishnavi’s team struggling with a movement-detection model. These are different accounts, not a controlled success-versus-failure comparison. Vaishnavi’s difficulty is not identified as a Copilot failure. Neither account tells us what a beginner working alone should expect.
